("Contractor"). 1. Duties and Responsibilities of Contractor. Contractor agrees to provide and Metro agrees to purchase the following goods and services: Ongoing maintenance to current Outdoor Early Warning Siren System, installation of new siren sites to the system, and repair of siren parts. This is not a requirements contract.
2. Delivery and instalfation. a) All deliveries must be made pursuant to written purchase order issued by Metro's Purchasing Agent. Metro assumes no liability for any goods delivered without such purchase order. b) Installation is required for the new sirens. Installation shall be completed within ninety (90) days after receipt of order. ARCHIVE

In no event shall the term of this contract, including extensions, exceed five (5) years.
4. Compensation.
